SPX.event_definition: 2 prior ATR directional move before 1 prior ATR adverse within next 5 contiguous minutes; greedy event anchors separated >5 bars; signal at anchor or <=3 minutes before; one-to-one
SPX.limits: Anchors define an operational forward movement, NOT independently established physical onset. Zero-lead separated. All data consumed research, no holdout, costs or live accuracy claim. Unscorable signals retained separately.
